representations.name: signed circuit-subtraction groupoid
representations.new_information: retains the full valuation-kernel vector and normalized cardinality defect when two circuits cancel a shared signed vertex
representations.first_test: classify common-witness stars by defect and test whether repeated subtraction terminates in a bounded set of petal-only bad supports

representations.name: defect-stratified failure-cluster complex
representations.new_information: records vertices, circuit intersections, subtraction residues, and defect labels on the entire connected overlap cluster
representations.first_test: compare equal-defect stars, mixed-defect books, and the core-with-private-satellites obstruction

representations.name: arithmetic cluster packing-repair primal dual
representations.new_information: allows repairs outside a chosen packed circuit and exposes whether one petal deletion can be reused across several clusters
representations.first_test: derive a dual certificate whose optimum is bounded by o(log N) times disjoint-circuit packing weight without restating the original transversal LP

representations.name: ordered full-residue transition DAG
representations.new_information: keeps the largest prime, signed cofactor ratio, and all lower-prime incidence links at each owner transition
representations.first_test: measure congestion on increasing-prime paths and overlapping universal double-star books

representations.name: divisor-current flow with logarithmic conductance
representations.new_information: routes numerator and denominator prime mass as a conserved signed current and prices an owner by logarithmic scale rather than residue alphabet size
representations.first_test: seek a cut inequality that is strict on every bad support but telescopes over repeated cofactor transfer

representations.name: owner congestion dual potential
representations.new_information: separates the owner map from a simpler dual load certificate depending only on reusable prime-occurrence capacity
representations.first_test: reject the representation if the dual feasibility constraints are exactly the original bad-support hitting constraints

representations.name: prime-scale coarea potential
representations.new_information: integrates residue support across logarithmic prime scales so long paths may telescope even when token count never decreases
representations.first_test: compute the exact total variation on RR.1 with adversarially spaced increasing primes

representations.name: convex merge-split residue energy
representations.new_information: credits merges of repeated cofactor states and debits splits, allowing cluster reuse to pay for local nondecrease
representations.first_test: test whether path books or double-star books can force the same energy increase at every transition

representations.name: full-occurrence cycle-space potential
representations.new_information: uses RR.3 density of cycle rank after deleting low-Omega integers but retains the actual matched occurrence graph rather than active-prime simplification
representations.first_test: prove that large occurrence cycle space supplies reusable repairs, or construct high-cycle-rank circuits with no such compression

representations.name: dyadic buffered revision reserve
representations.new_information: permits finite decisions to change inside explicitly budgeted boundary bands whose total upper density is summable
representations.first_test: make every future double-star completion charge a unique reserve scale and prove the scale charges are summable

representations.name: nested online transversal with recourse
representations.new_information: tracks both deletion cost and recourse when extending a transversal from H_N to H_M
representations.first_test: seek sublogarithmic competitive repair with zero-density cumulative recourse; reject any theorem equivalent to recomputing an optimal transversal

representations.name: density-convergent block diagonalization
representations.new_information: combines finite transversals on rapidly growing blocks with guard zones and two-sided density control between endpoints
representations.first_test: quantify cross-block product relations and show guard zones absorb them at summable density cost
